description: This file contains the implementation of functions for managing the NumberingPlan configuration within a telephony voice management system. It includes functions for getting and setting ULONG parameters, retrieving table entries, and getting/setting string parameters related to numbering plans and prefix information.

methods.name: BOOL NumberingPlan_GetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG * pValue)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a ULONG parameter for a numbering plan instance based on the param name.

methods.name: BOOL NumberingPlan_SetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG uValue)
methods.description: Sets the value of a ULONG parameter for a numbering plan instance based on the param name.

methods.name: ULONG PrefixInfo_GetEntryCount(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Returns the count of prefix info table entries (currently always 0).

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE PrefixInfo_GetEntry(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,ULONG nIndex,ULONG * pInsNumber)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific prefix info entry by index (currently not implemented).

methods.name: BOOL PrefixInfo_GetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG * pValue)
methods.description: Gets a ULONG parameter value for a specific prefix info instance based on the param name.

methods.name: LONG PrefixInfo_GetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pValue,ULONG * pUlSize)
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value from a prefix info instance.

methods.name: BOOL PrefixInfo_SetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pString)
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value in a prefix info instance.

methods.name: BOOL PrefixInfo_SetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG uValue)
methods.description: Sets a ULONG parameter value in a prefix info instance.
